summary: Session split across two context windows. App now shows NIF/phone/email/address in renderFicha() per client.
taskDescription: Integrate ANAGAN client contact data into seguimiento-cartera-anagan.html (547KB self-contained HTML app). App had policy/cartera seed data but lacked client contact info (NIF, phone, email, address). Built API connector to https://api.tesis.io/v2/ (Tesis Broker Manager REST API) to download 733 clients and inject contact data into HTML. Matters because app is live cartera management tool used daily by insurance agency.
currentStatus: DONE. 733 clients downloaded and injected into HTML clients-seed block. renderFicha() modified to show contact data. Button '🔄 Actualizar ANAGAN' added to toolbar with modal instructions. Actualizar-ANAGAN.ps1 script created for future refreshes. Token expires ~12h from session — user needs fresh token next time.
keyDecisions: Decision: API connector (Camino B) over name-based Excel matching — Reason: Excel ID column empty for all 733 rows, name matching ~85-90% accuracy insufficient, direct API access confirmed available

Decision: PowerShell script updates HTML file directly instead of in-page fetch — Reason: HTML served from file:// origin, API CORS only permits https://anagan.app.tesis.io, browser fetch would be blocked
Decision: Inject client data as separate <script id='clients-seed'> block alongside existing <script id='seed'> — Reason: preserves existing save/export flow unmodified, easy to update independently
Decision: Limit=50 with 15 pages for API pagination — Reason: API returns wrapper {items, total, totalPages} not bare array; 50 items/page balances speed and server load

Decision: Fields extracted: id, nif, tomador, telefonoMovil/telefonoPrincipal (first non-empty), email, direccionCompletaFiscal, localidad, provincia, cp, tipoDocumento — Reason: confirmed present in API response via field inspection

failedApproaches: Approach: $($_.Exception.Message) inside PS string literals → Result: ParseException 'variable reference not valid, : not followed by valid variable name char' → Lesson: Extract to temp var ($errMsg = $_.Exception.Message) before interpolating in PS5.1 strings

Approach: Iterate directly over $resp from Invoke-RestMethod → Result: got pagination envelope object instead of client array → Lesson: API wraps results in {items:[], total:N, totalPages:N}, must use $resp.items

Approach: Pass full JWT token inline in long PowerShell command string → Result: token silently truncated/corrupted mid-string, causing 401 Unauthorized → Lesson: Assign JWT to $t1 variable first, then build $token = 'Bearer $t1' separately

Approach: gstack browse skill (headless Chromium) for web browsing → Result: Server failed to start within 15s on Windows environment → Lesson: Use computer-use screenshot of Edge DevTools instead on this Windows machine

implicitRules: App is a single self-contained HTML file — all state lives in embedded JSON seed blocks, no external dependencies except Google Fonts and XLSX.js CDN
API base: https://api.tesis.io/v2/ — CORS origin: https://anagan.app.tesis.io — Auth: Bearer JWT in Authorization header
JWT token expires in ~12 hours (exp - iat = 43200s); iat/exp are Unix timestamps in the payload
API pagination: GET /listadoClientes?grupos=...&page=N&limit=50 returns {items:[], total:733, totalPages:15, ...}
GET /countClientes returns {total:733, totalPages:N} — use for preflight count
Client ID in seed data: a[0] (field 'id') matches API response field 'id' exactly — this is the join key
Seed rawRows format: [id, cia, ef, vt, ramo, tom, rie, colid, col, tipo, sub, prima, est, pol, dni]
Hub conventions: catalan language, DM Sans font, #DC0028 red, #202020 dark, no external deps
Windows environment — Python unavailable, use PowerShell COM or Invoke-RestMethod for data tasks
